name: BlackTwist
description: BlackTwist MCP Server lets AI assistants manage your social media presence on Threads and Bluesky. Schedule and publish posts, create multi-post threads, track engagement analytics (views, likes, replies, follower growth), manage drafts, set up auto-reply follow-ups, and monitor posting consistency — all through natural language. Supports team workspaces with role-based access, so team members can collaborate on content. Available on free and paid plans, with advanced analytics on paid tiers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BlackTwist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BlackTwist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://blacktwist.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BlackTwist MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BlackTwist lists 23 MCP tools, including list_providers, list_posts, list_drafts, get_thread, create_post, edit_post, edit_thread, delete_thread, reschedule_thread, get_live_metrics, get_metric_timeseries, and get_post_analytics.
BlackTwist requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BlackTwist is developed by BlackTwist. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
